LanguageData.MX_Power_EquipmentInactive: This equipment's special combat bonuses are inactive. It can be used for ordinary combat.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Original: Zhaoli's full abilities and default combat stats.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_Original: Mingyuan's full abilities and default combat stats.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Balanced: Execution, healing, resurrection, Karma Links and growth, with moderate damage, bonuses and ability costs.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_Balanced: Life Burn, Self Burn, Overburn, both bow forms, Time Burn, flame repair and rebirth, with moderate damage, layer gain and cooldowns.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Decorative: Focused on companionship, appearance and story. Abilities, growth, Karma income, linked death substitution and automatic rebirth are inactive. Equipment provides basic combat capability. Existing fields and enchantments end.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_Decorative: Focused on companionship, appearance and story. Abilities and combat passives are inactive; the bow fires ordinary single arrows. Existing sustained effects end. Rebirth already in progress completes.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Duanzhan: Unleashes a circular slash followed by a stronger forward cut, favoring torso hits. An active Netherflame enchantment adds fire damage.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_DeathField: Creates a radius-9 Death Sentence field for 9 seconds. Non-immune units other than the caster are slowed by 20%, receive cuts and gain 1 accumulation each second. At 9 points they are executed; a successful execution grants 1 Karma and 5 Deathward counters. Accumulation rapidly decays outside the field. Cooldown: 48 seconds. Neiyu, Qinghe, Zhaoli and Mingyuan are immune to its accumulation, slow, cuts and execution.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Guiyi: Costs 3.6 Karma to restore missing parts, wounds and treatable harmful conditions, and creates a 30-day Karma Link. At most 6 targets can be linked. Cannot target the caster or enemies. Cooldown: 18 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Dingshu: Costs 9.6 Karma and channels for about 41.7 seconds to resurrect and repair a corpse, creating a Karma Link and a 3-day Destiny Mark. A target that dies again while marked cannot be resurrected again. Unavailable during raids.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Minghuo: Costs 3 Karma to enchant the current primary weapon for 60 seconds. Damage, armor penetration, hit chance and attack speed increase by 21.25%, melee reach increases by 0.85 cell, and melee hits add fire damage. Cooldown: 180 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Minshen: Costs 3 Karma and affects enemies in a 13×13 area. Flesh targets take 0.85 armor-ignoring damage to the torso each second for 5 seconds, and have a 8.5% chance to become dazed for 7 seconds; otherwise their movement falls by 38.25% for 7 seconds. Non-flesh targets receive EMP. Cooldown: 18 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Passives: Gains Karma through Death Sentence. Healing and resurrection create up to 6 Karma Links lasting 30 days; living links can substitute for death. Recruited death growth caps at 10 deaths. Without a substitute, returns after 10 days.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_Bow: Focus: 50-cell range, line of sight required, 3-second charge. Consumes all Life Burn on the target, dealing 34 armor-ignoring damage plus 0.51 per layer, capped at 187 damage per shot. Radiation: fires into a 10-cell, 108-degree cone at most once every 1.5 seconds. Enemies take 0.85 burn damage and gain 45 Life Burn plus 3.6% of their burst threshold, capped at 108 layers. Overburn further increases the layers applied.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_Sword: Mingyuan's cinder blade, filled with searing scarlet flame. Its attacks interact with Self Burn, Overburn and Life Burn, and it improves melee dodge and weapon damage.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_AscendantFlameDash: Becomes flame and dashes up to 35 cells along a 3-cell-wide path without requiring line of sight. Enemies take 8.5 base burn damage, gain 27 Life Burn, are pushed back and stunned for 1 second. Scorch lasts 5 seconds and adds 5.4 Life Burn each second. Cooldown: 9.6 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_InstantCombustion: Deals 0.85 base burn damage separately to each enemy brain and eye within 12 cells, and stuns for 3 seconds. Doubles existing Life Burn and ignites unburning targets. Charge: 3 seconds. Cooldown: 144 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_BurningPillar: Charges for 3 seconds to place a burning core within 40 cells. The core expands to a 10-cell radius over 3 seconds, then can be moved. Lasts 30 seconds. Each second, enemies take a combined 12.75 base burn and cut damage and gain Life Burn. Hostile and factionless buildings take 5.1% of their maximum health as base damage per second. Cooldown: 288 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_TimeBurn: Charges for 3.6 seconds, then burns away the target's biological age over 20 seconds to execute it. Mechanoids dissolve into steel and plasteel; buildings return raw materials. Cooldown: 360 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_AshesOfSelf: Adds 20% blood loss and grants 100 Self Burn. Creates a moving 2.4-cell-radius field for 10 seconds. Every 0.5 seconds it burns enemies and adds Life Burn, heals the caster's wounds and scars, and builds Self Burn. Cooldown: 36 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_LifeBurn: Every 2 seconds, Life Burn deals damage, drains needs, advances age and wears equipment. It bursts at the target's threshold and can spread to nearby enemies on death. Focus and Absorb consume existing layers to deal damage.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_SelfBurn: Self Burn grows while drafted. Bonuses apply in steps of 10 layers, up to 300. Overburn increases direct damage and Life Burn output and drains the flame reserve. Every 10 seconds it consumes all excess layers in a radius-5 explosion for 1 damage per layer; allies can be hit.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_BurningBody: Improves consciousness. Immune to heat and explosion damage; these hits replenish 2 repair reserve at most once per second. Heals up to 13.5 points of ordinary injuries every 72 seconds. Taking actual damage grants 5 Self Burn and 0.2 seconds of invulnerability and burns hostile attackers in return.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_ProtectiveFlameShield: Checks injuries every 10 seconds. Spends 1 reserve to restore one missing part or heal wounds and scars on one part. Stable Self Burn and heat hits replenish reserve; Overburn drains it. The reserve itself does not absorb damage.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_RebirthFlame: At the brink of death, Mingyuan releases an explosion that damages and stuns nearby enemies, then leaves temporarily. She returns fully restored when the flame reforms.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Shield: Absorbing a unit through Death Pronouncement grants 5 Deathward Shield layers. Taking damage consumes 1 layer, including each damage-over-time tick. Layers record accumulated pronouncements and do not absorb damage.
LanguageData.MX_Power_BalancedEquipment: Dedicated armor that provides protection and equipped bonuses.
LanguageData.MX_Power_MX_Neiyu_WarpFeather: After a brief cast, creates 12–24 Milira feathers. Cooldown: 360 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Power_MX_Neiyu_ThunderMarkedStorm: Marks enemies within 3 cells. After a delay, each target receives 3 strikes, each dealing 30 base damage plus a 13-point EMP effect. Cooldown: 96 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Power_MX_Neiyu_Bow_ArrowBarrage: Requires bow form. Charges for 5 seconds, then fires 32 arrows in the selected direction, each with 26 base damage and a 55-cell range. Cooldown: 144 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Power_MX_Neiyu_Flower_BlessingField: Requires flower form. Heals wounds and scars on non-hostile flesh targets within 6 cells and improves mood. For 60 seconds, movement increases by 17%, incoming damage falls by 8.5%, and immunity gain increases by 59.5%. Cooldown: 108 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Power_MX_Neiyu_Flower_ToxinGarden: Requires flower form. Inflicts food poisoning on enemies within 7 cells, with a 8.5% chance to cause berserk rage. Cooldown: 144 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Power_MX_Neiyu_Sword_Skyfall: Requires sword form. Rises and marks the landing zone, dealing 102 armor-ignoring damage to enemies within 3 cells. They take 21.25% more damage for 25 seconds. Cooldown: 180 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Power_MX_Neiyu_Sword_ExecuteHead: Requires sword form. Retreats briefly, then dashes to the target. Decapitates a target that is downed or at no more than 25% overall health. If decapitation is not possible, deals 64 armor-ignoring cut damage. Cooldown: 90 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Neiyu_Shield: Stage I blocks one attack and enters Stage II; a lethal attack triggers Stage III directly. Stage II has 43 charges. Each hit consumes 1 charge per 36 damage, rounded up, with a minimum of 1. Returns to Stage I after 72 seconds without losing charges. Depleting the shield triggers Stage III. Stage III absorbs damage for 10 seconds, then grants buffs based on the amount absorbed for 40 seconds. High-absorption bonuses stack up to 5 times. Afterwards, weakness lasts 150 seconds: Stage II has only 22 charges and cannot block when empty or trigger Stage III.
